detail.longDescription: On IBKR, and using ib_insync, I am having problems placing stop limit orders in pre/post markets. The first limit order order goes through smoothly, but the stop limit does not appear. On IBKR, the screen requires a "transmit" action, showing that the transmit=True on the stop loss has not reached the TWS station. What to do? note: in the code below, reversing stop and limit prices in the limit stop loss does not change the outcome. from ib_insync import IB, Stock, LimitOrder, StopLimitOrder # Connect to Interactive Brokers TWS or IB Gateway ib = IB() ib.connect("127.0.0.1", 7497, clientId=1) # Define the contract (e.g., AAPL) contract = Stock("ORCL", "SMART", "USD") parent_id = ib.client.getReqId() # 1. Buy Limit Order outside Regular Trading Hours (RTH) # outsideRth=True allows the order to trigger/fill during pre-market or after-hours limit_order = LimitOrder( action="BUY", orderId=parent_id, totalQuantity=10, lmtPrice=160.00, outsideRth=True, # Crucial parameter for outside RTH execution ) limit_order.transmit = False # 2. Stop Limit Order outside Regular Trading Hours (RTH) # Requires a stop trigger price and a limit price, with outsideRth=True stop_limit_order = StopLimitOrder( action="SELL", totalQuantity=10, stopPrice=146.00, lmtPrice=145.00, parentId= limit_order.orderId, orderId=limit_order.orderId + 1, outsideRth=True, # Crucial parameter for outside RTH execution ) stop_limit_order.transmit = True # Place the orders limit_trade = ib.placeOrder(contract, limit_order) stop_limit_trade = ib.placeOrder(contract, stop_limit_order) print("Orders placed successfully outside RTH.")
